question: In the comparison of 4-nitrophenol reduction catalysts made for the Ni–Ag/rGO study, what rate constant k and normalized rate constant K does Ag/g-C3N4 have?
rendered: According to the excerpt [Enhanced catalytic reduction of 4-nitrophenol using magnetic Ni-Ag bimetal supported on reduced graphene oxide, page 9], Table 1 shows the parameter comparison of 4-NP reduction by different catalysts. For Ag/g-C3N4, the rate constant k is 0.1375 min−1 and the normalized rate constant K is 0.65.
